request.style: English, male solo baritone, warm and resolute, acoustic guitar, cello, flute, timpani, solemn hymn, 80 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
The sons of Joseph spoke to Joshua,
Saying why one lot for us today,
We are a numerous and blessed people,
Yet we receive but one inheritance.

[Verse]
Joshua answered with a firm command,
Go up into the forest land,
Clear ground in the land of Perizzites,
Where the Rephaim dwell in old days.

[Verse]
They said the hill country is too cramped,
And Canaanites in valleys strong,
They have iron chariots of war,
In Beth-shean and Jezreel ground.

[Verse]
Then Joshua spoke to Ephraim and Manasseh,
You have great strength and power immense,
The hill country shall be yours to take,
Though it is forest, clear it well.

[Verse]
It shall be yours to its farthest limits,
Drive out the Canaanites who stay,
Even with iron chariots strong,
You will make the land your own.

[Outro]
The forest cleared and the land is mine.
